title: AssistantDiscussionAdapter
description: The finite vocabularies Epic #443 pins for the AI Discussion UI Adapter (Issue #444, Phase 1). `docs/ai-discussion-adapter.md` §1 is the canonical contract; `docs/assistant-discussion.md` §1/§2 are the canonical contract for the underlying thread/proposal persistence these vocabularies describe (unchanged by this Epic). This schema does not describe a new persisted row shape -- Phase 1 adds no database table -- it exists so `tests/test_discussion_contract_parity.py` has one machine-checkable source alongside the server `Literal`s (`app/models.py`) and the Dashboard unions (`src/api/types.ts`) for every enum this Epic's registry introduces or touches. Each `$defs` entry below is referenced elsewhere as `#/$defs/<name>` rather than restated.

discussion_scope.description: docs/assistant-discussion.md §1.1. Fixed per target_kind (never chosen by the caller) via the scope -> target_kind first-match table `app/discussion_adapters.py`'s registry derives `SCOPE_TARGET_KINDS` from.

discussion_target_kind.description: docs/ai-discussion-adapter.md §1.1/§1.2. One `DiscussionAdapter` per value, registered in `app/discussion_adapters.DISCUSSION_ADAPTERS` -- an unregistered value is refused fail-closed (422 discussion_target_kind_unregistered) rather than silently degrading. Phase 1 (#444) covers exactly the 9 kinds Epic #436 (#438) already shipped; #447 adds Purpose/Stakeholder/Objective/Feature kinds in a later phase, additively.

discussion_target_state.description: docs/assistant-discussion.md §1.3. Derived at read time from the captured digest vs. the target's current canonical digest -- never a stored column, so an edited target cannot keep reporting a stale answer as current.

discussion_capability.description: docs/ai-discussion-adapter.md §1.3. Derived from what a DiscussionAdapter actually declares (`fields`/`relations`/`children`/`ui_draft_forms`/`joint_understanding_bridge`) -- never a stored column or a second constant, so a capability can never drift from the adapter that is supposed to back it. In Phase 1 every adapter's `ui_draft_forms` and `children` are empty and `joint_understanding_bridge` is false, so only `read_canonical`, `propose_fields`, and `propose_relations` are ever actually derived true; `read_ui_draft`, `prefill_form`, and `promote_joint_understanding` become reachable in Phases 2/3/6 without widening this enum.

discussion_proposal_item_kind.description: docs/assistant-discussion.md §2.3. Unchanged by Epic #443 Phase 1 -- included here so the parity test can check it alongside the adapter vocabularies above in one place.

discussion_proposal_item_status.description: docs/assistant-discussion.md §2.3. The item's OWN persisted lifecycle -- separate from `discussion_proposal_item_eligibility`, which is derived at read time and never stored (§2.2).

discussion_proposal_item_eligibility.description: docs/assistant-discussion.md §2.2's first-match order: forbidden -> stale -> conflict -> appliable. Derived at read time from the target's CURRENT canonical digest and the item's own status/address, never stored.
